description: This PHP file defines the Backup controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, providing functionalities for managing database backups such as listing, creating, restoring, uploading, downloading, and deleting backup files.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Controller class for handling database backup operations in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the backup management page, initializes data for view rendering including table list, history, and UI components.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves list of backup files with size, date, and download links, formatted for display.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Creates a backup task for selected database tables after permission and validation checks.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Schedules a restore task from a specified backup file, with permission and existence validation.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of a SQL backup file, including validation of file type and size, permission checks.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Provides a backup file download with permission validation and proper headers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified backup files after permission and validation checks.
